name: Split
description: An image beside a block of text — eyebrow, heading, a markdown body and buttons — on either side, stacked on phones. The media-and-text section of a landing page (Gutenberg media-text, a two-column Elementor container with an image, Divi's image + text row).

imageSide.description: Which side the image takes on wide screens: start (left in left-to-right text) or end. Phones always show it after the text.

ratio.description: The text column's share against the image's: equal, text 5 to image 7, or text 7 to image 5.

imageFit.description: contain: the image at its own proportions. cover: it fills the column's height.

imageShape.description: The image's corners: square, the theme's rounding, or a circle.

imageBleed.description: edge: the image runs on to the edge of the screen on its side (wide screens).

mediaKind.description: image: the picture. video: the picture is the poster of a video that loads only when played.

featureStyle.description: The marks of the points under the text: a check, or each point's own icon.

stackOrder.description: On a phone: the text first, or the picture first.

tone.description: Section background (brand: the site's brand colour; none: the page's own).

headingLevel.description: The heading's level: 2 under the page title; 3 or 4 when the section sits inside another.

body.label: Text
body.description: The text beside the image, as markdown: paragraphs, emphasis, links, lists.

actions.label: Buttons

href.label: Link
href.description: Where the button goes: a page on this site or a full address.

newTab.label: Open in a new tab
newTab.description: Open the link in a new tab (an external site the reader should not leave for).

style.label: Style
style.description: primary for the main action, secondary or ghost for the ones beside it.

actions.description: Buttons under the text, in order (Elementor button, Gutenberg buttons, Divi button).

image.label: Image

alt.label: Image description
alt.description: What the image shows, for readers who cannot see it; empty when it is decoration.

image.description: The image beside the text. Width and height, when known, let the site reserve its space.

features.label: Points

title.label: Title
title.description: The point, in a few words.

icon.label: Icon
icon.description: A kit icon name (check, star, bolt, shield, heart, globe, clock, chat).

features.description: Short points under the text (an Elementor icon list or icon box, a Gutenberg list), each with a title and a line.

videoUrl.label: Video
videoUrl.description: A video page (YouTube, Vimeo); the image is its poster and nothing loads from the provider until it is played.

id.description: Anchor id of the section; the heading gets `<id>-title`.

sticky.description: The picture stays in view while a long text scrolls past it (wide screens).

a11y: The section is labelled by its heading. The image is a separate figure in reading order after the text; an empty description marks a decorative one.
